title: alex-chen-people-ops-self-review-notes
content: Purpose: rough notes for my Q4/2025–Q1/2026 self-review and prep for 1:1 with Priya (manager). Keep it concise — examples + impact + asks.
Accomplishments (last 6 months):

- Rolled out new onboarding pulse survey and automated follow-up flows: 82% response rate in month 1, identified top 3 blockers (equipment, access, mentor scheduling); reduced first-month ticket volume by ~18% vs previous cohort. Linked to onboarding dashboard: JIRA-1710.

- Launched manager enablement playbook (pilot with Eng and Product): ran 3 workshops, created templates for goal-setting and 1:1 structure; adoption: 24 managers used templates in first 6 weeks, qualitative feedback positive (faster calibration, clearer expectations).

- Led compensation calibration prep for smaller teams (Finance + People Ops coordination): surfaced 12 borderline cases, recommended adjustments that reduced pay disparity at mid-levels; supported exec packet to CS and Eng leads.
- Ops improvements: consolidated four repeating offboarding steps into a single automated workflow (savings: ~2 FTE-hours/week across People Ops), fewer missed deprovisions reported in SRE runbook.
Impact highlights (how product/business benefited):
- Faster ramp for new hires -> earlier time-to-contribution; anecdotal notes from hiring managers show 1–2 weeks quicker access to key systems.
- Manager playbook increased clarity on expectations and helped two teams avoid misaligned OKRs during the quarter.
Areas to improve / honest weaknesses:
- Project prioritization: over-committed in Oct–Nov by owning too many pilots; need to delegate better and set clearer scope.
- Data tracking: still rely on manual exports for some headcount metrics; long-term I should partner with Analytics to build a canonical dashboard.
- Assertiveness in exec meetings: sometimes let conversations drift; prepare one clear recommendation + backup options for next sync.
Examples / evidence to cite in review:
- Onboarding pulse results (link to dashboard), before/after ticket volume spreadsheet (attached), screenshots from manager playbook survey.
- Manager workshop feedback (anonymized quotes) and adoption numbers.
Career goals (12–18 months):
- Short-term: move from program owner -> strategic partner for Eng/Product leads; own the manager enablement roadmap and measurable SLOs (manager response NPS, goal clarity metric).
- Mid-term: technical HR programs ownership (comp bands + leveling framework) and run cross-functional calibration cycles end-to-end.
- Learning: deepen analytics skills (SQL + Looker), take 1:1 coaching on stakeholder influencing.
Promotion readiness notes (what I need):
- Evidence of impact at org-level (metrics showing improved retention/ramp/manager effectiveness).
- Sponsorship: ask Priya and one other exec to be a referee for promotion packet. Prep a 2-page packet with key wins + cross-functional testimonials.
Manager prep / asks for 1:1 (Priya):
- Feedback request: where do you see biggest gaps for me to be considered for L4 -> L5? Specific examples welcome.
- Resource ask: can we get 0.2 FTE from Analytics to build canonical headcount/ramp dashboard? I can define schema and acceptance criteria.
- Delegation plan: want to hand off two pilots (manager playbook ops + onboarding microimprovements) to Daniel. Can you support the handoff timeline?
- Compensation calibration: want to discuss a timeframe + expectations for submitting promotion packet if we decide to move forward this cycle.
Open questions / decisions to make:
- Which metric should be the north star for manager enablement? Adoption alone feels weak; consider manager effectiveness NPS + downstream impact on team ramp/retention.
- Timeline for promotion packet: ideal to submit by end of Q2 2026. Is that aggressive? What milestones should I hit before then?
Quick talking points for 1:1 (2–3 mins each):
- 'This quarter I focused on onboarding + manager enablement; measurable wins: 82% pulse response and 24 managers adopted templates.'
- 'I want to scale these programs by partnering with Analytics and delegating ops so I can focus on strategy and compensation work.'
- 'Ask: 0.2 FTE from Analytics, approval to nominate two projects for delegation, and feedback on promotion readiness.'
Notes to self (action items after 1:1):
- Draft 2-page promotion packet outline (examples from Confluence), add 3 cross-functional testimonials and export onboarding metrics (due: 2026-03-08).
- Create handoff checklist for Daniel and schedule overlap weeks (2 weeks shadowing + runbook).
- Send follow-up email with prioritized asks and owners + dates.
Misc: keep this doc live — add any feedback Priya gives and mark action items with dates. Use tags to track progress (promotion, analytics, delegation).
--- End of notes ---
